## D — Accuracy and source controls for Laws restraints and related issues
The laws restraints and related issues facts are authored from the selected official physical pages and preserve the actor, triggering condition and exceptions described there.
Source confidence is high for page fidelity; current legal applicability is limited by the old edition and recorded freshness debt.
Image-only information has not been converted into unsupported facts; any diagram-dependent learning surface needs its own evidence review.
The preaccept fact-check receipt is same-model review only; independent coverage and fact QA remain pending.
Quantified crash/ejection and heatstroke illustrations are held as contextual evidence rather than universal predictions (verify PA-RESTRAINTS-SAFETY-NUMBERS).
Service fees, phone/interpreter scheduling and county emissions eligibility require current verification (verify PA-RESTRAINTS-SERVICES).
The dated anti-texting statute's fine, device exemptions and preemption wording remain legal-currentness debt (verify PA-RESTRAINTS-TEXTING).
The bicycle centerline exception must be reconciled with earlier general double-yellow passing rules during independent QA; no earlier accepted wording is changed.

corpus_stability.reason: The issuer currently links the PUB 95 (4-21) handbook; no frequent-rewrite evidence is asserted. Edition age and absent effective date remain accuracy debt in part A.

verification_debt.claim_text: Physical93 injury-force/ejection ratios,30mph building comparison,12mph fatality example,1/50second stopping,25-times ejection risk,150feet ejection,4-of-5 survival;94 child crash totals and heatstroke80sF/10minute illustration lack individualized/dated context. Do not emit as universal predictions.

Physical93 update-card zero-fee assertion and phone routes,95 interpreter two-week/three-date phone arrangements,96 county/model-year1975 emissions applicability and hotline are currentness debt. Accommodation concepts are retained without promising current channels.

Physical97 describes the March8,2012 anti-texting law,50-dollar fine, IWCD definition, local preemption, no seizure and GPS/integrated/transit device exclusions. Current handheld-device law and exception scope must be checked before these historical details become learner rules.
